en:
Nyeeeh, I've got so much motivation now!
I can't wait till the Electrohammer recharges!
C-Calm down, Himiko!

If you expend all your energy now, you won't
have any when you really need it.
Nyeh? I see. That's true, too.

But...who would've imagined that we're the last
hope of humanity and this was a spaceship.

That's not right! Are they really gonna throw
away the whole magic theme just like that?

Ah...was there a "magic theme"
in the first place?

But...who would've imagined that we're the last
hope of humanity and this was a spaceship.

We had such a strong magic theme up till now...
What happened to that?

Did you come out of your room because
you couldn't calm down?
Yeah...
I was the same. I couldn't stay still.

This morning I barely had the willpower to get
out of bed... It's all thanks to Maki.
I can hardly believe it...

Maki who was so tsundere in the beginning,
is now the one pulling us along...
But, it's probably because of Kaito's influence.
Huh? Why do you think that?
Huh? Why? You can tell just by looking...
Maki's interested in Kaito.

Otherwise, she wouldn't be watching the 
hangar the whooooole time like she is.
Ah, y-yes, I suppose that's true...

Huh? Are you shocked? Were you guys 
in some reverse love triangle situation?
N-No! It's not like that at all!

Wow! I didn't mean to shock you like that.
Hehe, I just meant to mock you about Maki.
I wonder...

When we were at Hope's Peak Academy, 
did we have fun and tease each other like this?

Well, we were in different classes,
but I'm sure we had friends like that...

Even if we can't go back to that time, 
there's still hope left in the world...

I'm going to keep living with confidence 
till the end.

That's...my vow as one of the last 
students of Hope's Peak Academy.

There's still hope in the world... I'm going 
to live with confidence till the end.

That's...my vow as one of the last 
students of Hope's Peak Academy.

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item on the stone statue,
a building rose up...
<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of technology is this?

<CLT=cltMIND>When I placed the stone on the pedestal,
a building flew over here...

<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of technology is this?
Perhaps I shouldn't even think about it.
<CLT=cltMIND>So this was the key after all...
